args.sql:
WITH chain_stats AS (
    SELECT
        kod_tsepochki_zapuskov,
        ANY_VALUE(zadanie) AS zadanie,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'Успешно' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_success,
        MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'Успешно' THEN nomer_popytki END) AS first_success_attempt,
        COUNT(*) AS total_attempts_in_chain
    FROM "08_fonovye_zadaniya"
    GROUP BY kod_tsepochki_zapuskov
),
chain_flags AS (
    SELECT
        kod_tsepochki_zapuskov,
        zadanie,
        total_attempts_in_chain,
        CASE WHEN has_success = 1 AND first_success_attempt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_retry_success
    FROM chain_stats
)
SELECT
    zadanie,
    SUM(is_retry_success) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS share_retry_success_chains,
    AVG(CASE WHEN is_retry_success = 1 THEN total_attempts_in_chain ELSE NULL END) AS avg_attempts_in_retry_success_chains
FROM chain_flags
GROUP BY zadanie
ORDER BY share_retry_success_chains DESC
